I'd like to spotlight a project I led at Tata Consultancy Services, where we helped a major healthcare client optimize their AWS S3 storage costs using lifecycle policies and Intelligent-Tiering.

The context was a massive data lake with over 100TB of data, growing at 10TB per month. The problem was that the client was incurring significant costs due to unnecessary storage of infrequently accessed data in the standard S3 tier.

To solve this, we designed and implemented S3 lifecycle policies using the AWS Management Console and the AWS CLI. We used the `put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration` command to configure policies that transitioned objects to the Standard-IA tier after 30 days of inactivity, and to the Glacier Deep Archive tier after 365 days.

We also enabled Intelligent-Tiering on the bucket, which allowed S3 to automatically move objects between tiers based on access patterns. This was done using the `put-bucket-intelligent-tiering-configuration` API.

The impact was significant - we achieved a 25% reduction in S3 storage costs, resulting in annual savings of over $150,000. The client was able to optimize their storage costs without compromising on data durability or accessibility.

This project showcased the power of S3 lifecycle policies and Intelligent-Tiering in optimizing storage costs, and I'm excited to apply this expertise to future projects in the healthcare and biotech space.
